text:
Priya: Follow-up from the hosting abstraction RFC: proposing a much smaller runtime handshake ("probe-first shim") to replace the big stateful sidecar. Goal: single minimal surface across Hosted/Dedicated/Private that only negotiates capabilities, passes routing hints, and preserves tracing headers.

Evan: curious about the exact failure modes we intend to cover. My main concerns: secret exchanges (HSM/KMS), streaming semantics, and KV cache compatibility. Any mitigation sketches?

Priya: mitigation sketches: 1) keep secret-handling out of shim; for private/on-prem we provide an operator-managed injector (helm chart + docs). 2) streaming: add a binary streaming diff in the harness to detect chunking regressions. 3) KV: handshake advertises kv_layout version and shim rejects incompatible runtimes with a soft-fallback to legacy facade.

Ruth: operator-install for private is required. We cannot ask customers with contractual HSM integrations to rewire their keys. Plan: operator-side sidecar that injects headers post-authn; shim never holds keys.

Marco: rollout phases suggestion: (A) feature-flagged hosted alpha; (B) hosted canary + telemetry baseline; (C) dedicated opt-in tenants; (D) private via operator install; (E) flip default after 90 days stability. Need LB-level kill-switch to pivot traffic back to legacy facade.

Priya: agreed. shim will preserve headers: X-Redwood-Req-Id, traceparent, x-rw-route-hint. During canaries we emit x-rw-shim-debug with the probe outcome.

Evan: parity tests: run 3 traffic shapes (chat-short, chat-long-8k, embeddings) at 3 tps levels (100, 500, 1500). Collect P50/P95/P99, error classes, and token-cost-per-request. Regression thresholds: <3% on P95 and no new 5xx classes.

Ruth: add quality checks: sample 2k real prompts and compute exact tokenization equivalence when deterministic; otherwise compute embedding similarity and lexical diff. Also check streamed chunk boundaries.

Marco: config drift: add a manifest-lint rule to warn about legacy-facade-only fields. Also add preflight validation in Dedicated provisioning. If flag present, provisioning UI should warn tenant.

Priya: compatibility handshake format (example):

```
HTTP 200
Content-Type: application/json
{"capabilities": ["streaming:framed","kv:v3"], "supports_probe": true}
```

If runtime returns unsupported kv version shim will route to legacy facade or return 409 with migration-hint header.

Evan: what about in-flight KV pointers and cache keys? If we flip mid-flight we could have stale pointers. Need a migration window where facade stays alive and a background job migrates KV indexes. Also require pre-flip snapshot.

Marco: ops-bot: create snapshot and baseline jobs please.

ops-bot: jobs scheduled: handoff-snapshot-180123 (store=longterm, retention=30d), handoff-baseline-180123 (cadence=daily). link: https://ci.redwood/handoff/180123

Priya: CI: land prototype shim under experimental package and a manifest-linter rule in infra-lint. DevEx will add migration guide and playbook with diagnostics (prometheus queries, required logs, debug headers).

Ruth: security: operator install docs need review for HSM patterns. Tagging @security-team for review.

Evan: timeline proposal: prototype (2 weeks) -> harness + parity tests (1 week) -> hosted alpha (2 weeks) -> dedicated opt-ins (3 weeks) -> private operator rollout docs (2 weeks) -> GA flip after 12 weeks monitoring. Keep canary windows at least 2 weeks for hosted canaries.

Marco: ops approves tempo, assign me approver for LB kill-switch and snapshot verification.

ci-bot: PR opened: "probe-shim/handshake: initial prototype" - https://github.com/redwood-inference/rfcs/pull/4891

Priya: I'll draft the rollout playbook and include: test matrix, exact headers to preserve, manifest linter rules, operator helm snippet, and kill-switch runbook. Will ping this thread for review. Thanks everyone. :rocket:
